verdict.rationale: LibreChat's docs describe it as a self-hosted web app that you install yourself with Docker Compose (the recommended method), npm, or a Kubernetes Helm chart, and they include remote deployment guides. Independent community users report that installation was easy and that they have self-hosted it for about a year.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: Install LibreChat yourself with Docker, npm, or a Helm chart. It is a self-hosted web app, not a desktop installer.
For most scenarios, Docker Compose is the recommended installation method due to its simplicity, ease of use, and reliability.
Docker and npm run it on your own machine on Windows, macOS, or Linux and serve it at http://localhost:3080
Please follow this guidance to deploy LibreChat on Kubernetes using Helm
